title: docs(pm-dispatch): spec lane riders are any non-protocol change, the list is examples
body:
<!-- claude-projects-attribution: {"github_login":"zhuangjianguo"} -->
_Requested by **Steedos** · [project thread](https://claude.ai/code/project/chan_018ETKaNwMZCNRYD7D8Q9Ubb?thread=cmsg_018ETKaNwMZCNRYD7D8Q9UbbEzGspcEbyiDppwrPTqKofB)_

Fixes #31560

Clause-②: no
Metadata-protocol: none

## 维护者速读

- 改了什么:spec 车道边界里「哪些 `packages/spec` 改动可随产品 PR 搭车」从封闭清单改成判据:凡非元数据协议改动皆可搭车;原清单留作例子,并加上 liveness 引用行。
- 为什么改:你的裁决原意是「涉及元数据协议改动的，才需要让 spec 处理」;上一版写成「唯下列」,把 liveness 引用行修复(每个 PR 都会跑 `check:liveness`)读成了不许搭车。
- 风险与回滚:只改一个内部技能文件的两行,行数不变;回滚即 revert 本 PR。紧接其后的三行仍写明放宽或收窄接受集属协议改动,协议改动不能借此搭车。
- 先看:`.claude/skills/pm-dispatch/references/lanes/spec.md` 第 12 行与第 16 行。
- 两分钟验证:`pnpm check:pm-skill-ratchet`,预期退出 0(该文件 43 行,在上限内)。
- 需要你做的:无,席位落地。

## What changes

`.claude/skills/pm-dispatch/references/lanes/spec.md`, two lines, equal line count (43 → 43, the file's ratchet ceiling is 43), every line at most 119 bytes, no untouched line re-wrapped.

- L12 old: `` - 一般开发工具面留 devx;`packages/spec` 文件归本席,唯下列搭车改动可随产品 PR。 ``
- L12 new: `` - 一般开发工具面留 devx;`packages/spec` 文件归本席,非元数据协议改动皆可随产品 PR 搭车。 ``
- L16 old: `` - 可搭产品 PR 的 spec 改动:错误码台账行、平台名注册表、`contracts/`、JSDoc/describe、测试。 ``
- L16 new: `` - 搭车如:台账行(错误码、liveness 引用)、平台名注册表、`contracts/`、JSDoc/describe、测试等。 ``

L12 now states the test. L13 to L15 (unchanged) define metadata protocol as the authorable shape and say a widened or narrowed accept set is a protocol change, so the open test cannot be read as letting a protocol change ride. L16 is examples (「如…等」), with liveness citation rows (`packages/spec/liveness/**`) beside the error-code ledger rows.

Source: triage 6723626865 rules 「唯下列」 a transcription narrowing of ruling 6722023475; the claim is 6725167218.

## Tests

No code changes; gates only (see Verification).

## Acceptance notes

- Grep of `.claude/`, `AGENTS.md` and `scripts/pm/` for another statement of the closed rider list or 「唯下列」: none. `lanes/server.md` L6 and `SKILL.md` L175 point to `spec.md` without copying the list.
- No open PR edits `lanes/spec.md` (open PR file lists checked before the first push).

## Verification

<details><summary>dispatch-gates at 1f547b0d: 17 derived, 17 run, all exit 0</summary>

`node scripts/pm/dispatch-gates.mjs --commands --repo objectstack-ai/objectstack`, then `--ran`: 17 derived, 17 run, 0 NOT-MEASURED, 0 UNRUN. `check:doc-formula-expressions` first exited 3 (prerequisite not met), then exited 0 after building formula and lint. The roster gate under `.claude` (`pnpm check:pm-settings-deny-roster`) also exited 0. `pnpm check:pm-skill-ratchet` exited 0.

</details>
